data.title: bn-5fi: Bind qualified Evidence for stock full-depth reads
data.description: Qualify the operator-bound Investigation case and its exact retained manifest, compare the current indexed acceptance and pass inside the coherent read, and expose full-depth badges with typed integrity errors. Local metadata paths stay passive. Offline full check, strict all-feature Clippy, stock read tests with the exact Investigation binary, and all eight exact Evidence bridge tests passed. No target traffic.

data.body: [MEDIUM] The eager retained-manifest read runs before the bounded coherent-read retry path. A normal append between its evidence show/lineage/selector calls can return ChangedSnapshot (evidence/mod.rs:523-525), which stock read_finding immediately maps to INTEGRITY_FAILURE (read.rs:316-324; record.rs:193-200). That reports corruption on healthy concurrent Evidence activity. Retry/reclassify movement during open, or move retained-pin validation entirely inside the checkpointed attempt while preserving the verified-open contract. Add a focused movement regression.

[MEDIUM] A qualified full read skips its required indexed acceptance check when the engagement has no manifest rows. The early first() guard returns an inconclusive capture before the qualified closure reaches last() validation at lines 129-136. chain_intact checks verification and intent continuity, so a linked record and surviving retained pin can coexist with an absent manifest index. Stock show then returns a CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE blocker for corrupt/missing indexed acceptance. Make an absent index an integrity failure in the qualified path, and cover it alongside mismatched pass and revision.

[MEDIUM] Stock full show now publishes a current finding badge while ignoring persisted objections in the same snapshot. compute_linked always supplies default facts although capture already copies lead_events, and Disputed is reachable only through injected test facts. The existing objection concurrency test proves that the newer capture contains the objection, but never checks the badge. An objection that lands before the final accepted snapshot can therefore disappear behind an unchanged verified label and an empty stock event projection. Preserve the recorded objection in the stock projection and apply the material/unresolved status rule, or withhold an undisputed badge when that rule cannot yet be evaluated.

[LOW] A current snapshot with an established NeedsReview result is rendered as generic capability unavailability. A lead binding change or revoked oracle can produce this typed status with known status/deciding record identifiers. The current branch drops it and the standing gate would also reject its stale status record. Preserve the explicit NeedsReview state and record references for full show without implying the record is standing.

data.reason: Exact target cf53571fd17812578afc8a5c219f4986c84c68b7 misclassifies normal Evidence snapshot movement and absent manifest indexes, and can publish a current undisputed badge while a recorded objection is present. See th-3h0x4a, th-2voc24, and th-3jmec1.

data.body: Fixed. The qualified opener retries ChangedSnapshot up to three times and the stock read treats exhausted movement as unavailable. Stable integrity errors still fail immediately. The opener regression covers eventual success, exhaustion and immediate integrity refusal.

Fixed. Qualified capture names the evidence checkpoint from the operator pin even when the coordination index is absent, so the required latest acceptance comparison emits INTEGRITY_FAILURE. A stock process test deletes only the index and checks the typed failure.

Fixed. A current unassessed objection withholds an otherwise verified or conditional badge and emits a redacted notice. The record has no typed materiality or resolution, so the projection makes no adjudication. The SQLite overlap test now verifies the projected badge is withheld when the persisted event reaches the accepted snapshot.

Fixed. Current needs_review findings preserve both record references and unestablished applicability while keeping the standing-record list empty for the stale record. Projection and wire/text regressions cover the stale binding.

data.reason: Verified at 8a3e27e: bounded reopen checks retry ChangedSnapshot, stable errors keep their type, and stock show treats exhausted movement as unavailable. The coherent attempt also rechecks retention and retries movement.

Verified at 8a3e27e: the operator pin names the Evidence checkpoint independently of the index. The newest indexed acceptance is required and its revision, artifact and pass are compared. The stock regression checks an absent row returns INTEGRITY_FAILURE.

Verified at 8a3e27e: a persisted objection in a current coherent snapshot withholds the undisputed badge and emits a redacted notice. The overlap regression covers both the historical fallback and the accepted current objection.

Verified at 8a3e27e: stale status retains needs_review, unestablished applicability and both record IDs. The stale record remains excluded from standing_true. The new human-output handling for unavailable oracle identities has a separate finding.

data.body: [LOW] An unavailable oracle can put terminal controls in stock text and pretty output. VersionedDigest accepts WireText for both ID and version, and its validator excludes only empty strings and NUL (crates/scourge-core/src/ids.rs:59). An unregistered retained oracle yields OracleUnavailable (crates/scourge-verify/src/record.rs:1315), which status maps to a nonstanding NeedsReview result (status.rs:377 and 477-480). The new projection copies the unchecked identity into the finding (coherent_read.rs:255-288) and write_finding passes it to write_fields as raw terminal text (read.rs:679 and 748-752). A digest-bound archive authenticates the referenced bytes, and an unrecognized oracle identity remains untrusted display data. Render only safe inert oracle identifiers or escape terminal controls at the human output boundary. Preserve needs_review and both record references, and cover the unavailable-oracle projection in text and pretty output.
